This isn't a protest. It's a recipe. Like making bread, except instead of bread it's curing diseases, and instead of yeast it's (legal) bribes.

## High-Level Strategy: The Three-Step Recipe for Not Dying

Humans love steps. You put them on everything. Step 1: Breathe. Step 2: Keep breathing. Step 3: Try not to die. You're very methodical about staying alive. That makes it curious that you spend {{< var military_to_government_clinical_trials_spending_ratio >}} times more on weapons than testing which medicines work.

![How to stop spending money on death and start spending it on life, in three simple steps. You'd think this would be obvious.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-high-level-strategy-the-three-step-recipe-for-not-dying-bw-academic.jpg)

Here's your three-step algorithm for fixing this adorable contradiction:

### Step 1: Collect Papers from Rich People

You convince wealthy humans to give you a large pile of [papers](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) by promising them returns that make military contractors nervous. This works because rich people are excellent at counting papers but terrible at not wanting more papers.

The pitch is simple: "Give us papers now, get more papers forever, also maybe don't die from preventable diseases." Even humans who think vaccines cause 5G can understand "more papers good."

### Step 2: Tell Humans the Referendum Exists

Use some papers to launch a [global marketing campaign](global-referendum.qmd) so {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} people learn there's a referendum and vote on it. This achieves more than most political movements involving shouting.

![Enough people vote on a referendum. Politicians notice. Democracy, but with more clicking and less dying.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-step-2-pay-humans-to-click-yes-bw-academic.jpg)

The referendum isn't a simple yes/no. Each voter gets a [wishocratic slider](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) to set their preferred allocation between military spending and clinical trials. The results are aggregated to determine humanity's collective preferred split. It's a species-wide budget meeting. You'd think the outcome would be obvious. But humans once thought the sun went around Earth, so you have to ask.

This creates what's called "political pressure." That's when politicians realize that voters exist and some of them have opinions.

### Step 3: Apply Papers to Politicians Until Treaty Happens

[Deploy the remaining papers](../legal/election-law.qmd) to convince politicians that supporting the treaty is the only way to remain employed.

![Voters complain, papers stack up, money moves from bombs to medicine. It's like recycling, but for budgets.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-step-3-apply-papers-to-politicians-until-treaty-happens-bw-academic.jpg)

The treaty passes. {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year flows from murder to medicine. Forever. Or until the sun explodes. Whichever happens first (probably the sun).

## The Sacred (Legal) Bribery Sequence

Humans respond to papers. This is your most important discovery about Earth. You tried appealing to morality (failed). You tried appealing to logic (failed harder). But papers? Papers work every time.

![Which humans get which papers, so the right bribes reach the right people. Organization charts, but honest.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-tactical-implementation-the-sacred-legal-bribery-sequence-bw-academic.jpg)

Here's the precise order for distributing papers to specific categories of humans:

### (Legal) Bribe Category #1: Rich People (The Paper Collectors)

**Who you're (legally) bribing:** Wealthy humans who have many papers and want even more papers, despite already having more papers than they could spend in several lifetimes

**The (legal) bribe you offer:** Modeled on WW2 War Bonds [@wwii-war-bonds], except instead of 4% returns for funding death, these pay {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} for funding not-death. Like war bonds except backwards.

**Why they accept:** Because rich humans can read a spreadsheet, and no spreadsheet in history has ever said "give up {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} annual returns because you feel weird about the source."

**Money-back guarantee:** If the treaty fails, they get their papers back via assurance contracts. Funds are escrowed until milestones hit. Automatic refund if targets are missed. This is basically saying "if everyone dies from preventable diseases, you'll be too dead to complain about losing money."

**What happens:** Defense contractors lose 1% of their revenue but discover a new {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year health spending market has appeared where there used to be nothing. The same companies that build missile guidance systems can build medical device supply chains. It turns out building things that go inside humans isn't that different from building things that go inside other humans' countries. The main difference is whether the end user survives.

#### The Specific Offer to Bomb Makers

You show weapons manufacturers a spreadsheet (they love spreadsheets):

#### Option A (Current Job)

- Operating margin: 8%
- Product: Things that make humans stop existing
- Customer satisfaction: N/A (customers deceased)
- Market outlook: Shrinking by 1%

#### Option B (Your Offer)

- Operating margin: Similar, except nobody dies (this is new for them)
- Product: Things that make humans continue existing
- Customer satisfaction: Very high (customers still alive to provide feedback)
- Market outlook: Expanding (see [Phase 4+](#phase-4-the-expansion-phases-years-4-50))

They choose Option B. Not because they've had a moral awakening, but because their shareholders can read a market forecast. Weapons manufacturers don't have feelings, but they do have quarterly earnings calls.

### (Legal) Bribe Category #2: The True Believers (Early Adopters)

**Who you're (legally) bribing:** Humans who believe in curing diseases AND want to get rich doing it. These exist. They're called "effective altruists" except they also want a yacht. On Wishonia we call them "normal," but on Earth apparently wanting to do good AND get paid for it is a whole personality type.

**The (legal) bribe you offer:** Give {{< var campaign_phase1_budget >}} to get the referendum started (the full thing costs {{< var treaty_campaign_viral_referendum_base_case >}}, but you don't need all of it upfront because humans love joining things that are already working). In return, they get [VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) paying {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} annually. They're first in line for a {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year pie that didn't exist before they showed up.

**What they fund:** The [Global Referendum](global-referendum.qmd) marketing campaign. Getting {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} people to learn the referendum exists and vote on it.

**What they get:** {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns for as long as the treaty holds. And since their personal wealth now depends on the treaty surviving, they will use their considerable pre-existing influence over government, media, and other humans to make sure nobody repeals it. You didn't buy their influence. You bought their self-interest. Their influence comes free.

**Why this works:** You give them money. They give you money back, plus more money. On Wishonia this is called "a transaction." On Earth it's called "investing," and humans will do absolutely anything for it.

### (Legal) Bribe Category #3: Regular People (Everyone Else)

**Who you're (legally) bribing:** {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} regular humans ({{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} of your species, which history proves is enough to change anything). It's like reaching critical mass, except instead of a nuclear explosion it's democracy (much less lethal).

**The (legal) bribe you offer:** Vote on the referendum via [wishocratic slider](../solution/wishocracy.qmd). Get paid for [telling your friends about it](global-referendum.qmd). It's a pyramid scheme where the thing at the top of the pyramid is not dying from preventable diseases.

**What happens after:** Treaty passes. {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year flows to clinical trials. Diseases get cured faster. Your healthcare improves. Also, {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} humans now have a personal stake in this thing continuing, and there is nothing more dangerous on Earth than a large group of humans who were promised something.

**Why this works:** Humans love having opinions. Humans love getting paid. Humans (allegedly) love not dying. This combines all three. When {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} of the population has voted on something, politicians experience what you call "responsive governance."

### (Legal) Bribe Category #4: Politicians (The Elected Paper Recipients)

**Who you're (legally) bribing:** Humans whose job is "get elected by promising things, then do whatever the people with papers want." Politicians are simple organisms with one evolutionary drive: reelection. Currently, weapons manufacturers feed this drive. You're going to feed it better, the way you'd lure a dog away from garbage with a steak.

![Three ways to move politicians: bribe their campaign, threaten their job, or make them rich. You built a machine with three bribe settings.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-legal-bribe-category-4-politicians-the-elected-paper-recipients-bw-academic.jpg)

**The (legal) bribe you offer:** Super PAC support from the {{< var treaty_campaign_budget_lobbying >}} lobbying budget. {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} voters demanding the treaty. Plus [cushy jobs after they leave office](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) for politicians who vote yes: fellowships, board seats, speaking circuits. You know, the things politicians actually want. Insurance companies realize healthy people file fewer death claims. Suddenly their lobbyists become your lobbyists. It's beautiful. Like watching a dog realize the mailman has treats.

#### The Package

![Four rivers of money and pressure, all flowing toward one senator. You call this 'The Package.' The Mafia calls it Tuesday.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-the-package-bw-academic.jpg)

- **Papers for campaigns:** Massive Super PAC funding (legal bribery)
- **Votes for staying employed:** Referendum voters who will vote for treaty supporters
- **Post-office rewards:** Fellowships, board seats, and speaking circuits for politicians who vote yes
- **Power to reward friends:** Direct a portion of the 1% Treaty Fund's {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}} to their home districts (funding pragmatic clinical trials and building decentralized institutes of health for decades of ribbon-cutting ceremonies)

#### The choice you give them

**Option A:** Support treaty, get papers + votes + legacy as "politician who cured diseases"

**Option B:** Oppose treaty, discover {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} voters wanted to not die (they're voting against you)

Most politicians are excellent at counting votes. The math becomes simple even for them.

**What happens:** Politicians discover they've always been passionate about curing diseases. This sudden passion perfectly coincides with receiving papers and votes. On your planet, that's called "representative democracy."

### The Success Spiral

Each category of bribe creates the next. Rich people fund the referendum. The referendum creates voters. Voters pressure politicians. Politicians pass the treaty. The treaty makes money. Money funds more cures. Cures prove it works. More people demand expansion.

This is the first time in your history that "I prefer being alive" has been organized into a political position. This seems obvious, but for humanity it's revolutionary.

And unlike current government, where money and influence are tangled in ways nobody can trace, this system keeps them separate. Investors get money ({{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}}). Politicians get career incentives ({{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}}). Neither group touches the {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}} that goes to clinical trials via [wishocratic allocation](../solution/wishocracy.qmd). The corruption is capped at 20%, transparent, and completely disentangled from the public goods funding. Your current system can't say any of those things.

### The Timeline: From $0 to Ending Death

You want to end war and disease. You need {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} in papers. You currently have $0 in papers (probably). Here's the recipe.

![Phase one: collect papers. Phase two: collect more papers. Phase three: 1 billion people sign, world changes. Bureaucracy saves humanity.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-the-paper-collection-timeline-from-0-to-ending-death-bw-academic.jpg)

1.  **Phase 1: Proof That Voting Works (Months 1-3).** You build a simple version of **[Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd)**. Basically a referendum platform where humans vote on whether to redirect 1% of the military budget to curing diseases. If anyone uses it, you've proven humans will participate in democracy when you make it easy and give them points. You show this to angel investors. Angel investors are humans who give you papers based on a PowerPoint and a dream. On Wishonia this is called "mental illness," but on Earth it's called "Silicon Valley."
2.  **Phase 2: Scale the Marketing, Hire Professional Bribers (Months 4-18).** Humans will vote when you make it easy and reward participation. You've proven that. Now you raise more papers from venture capitalists (humans who gamble professionally while wearing suits). You use these papers to market the referendum to millions of voters. You also hire your first professional lobbyists. Their actual job is "convince politicians that things are good."
3.  **Phase 3: The Big Paper Sale (Months 19-36).** This is the final boss level. You launch **[VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd)** to raise the full {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} you need. You overwhelm the opposition, run a global "please don't die" advertising campaign, and get the **[1% treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd)** signed by actual governments who thought weapons were the only option.

> **Feasibility Check:** The diplomatic phase alone is much cheaper than the full campaign. You raise {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} for high probability. See [Treaty Feasibility & Cost Analysis](../appendix/treaty-feasibility.qmd).

## The Legal Architecture: How to Be a Charity, a Lobbying Group, and a Hedge Fund Simultaneously

You need to fight on three fronts to win: moral (charity), political (lobbying), and financial (investment). The problem is your legal system says one organization can't do all three.

Your legal system is adorably complicated, like a board game designed by lawyers having a nightmare.

So you build a four-part machine:

- **The Charity (501c3):** This is the "brains." It does research and education. Rich foundations give papers here and get to feel good about themselves (plus tax deductions, which are like discount coupons for virtue).
- **The Lobbying Group (501c4):** This is the "sword." It takes the research and uses it to wage unlimited political warfare. That sounds scary but mostly involves lunch meetings and PowerPoints.
- **The Corporation (C-Corp):** This is the "engine." A for-profit entity that issues the VICTORY [Incentive Alignment Bonds](https://iab.warondisease.org) and collects the papers. Yes, you need a for-profit corporation to end death. Your species is hilarious.
- **The Swiss Foundation:** This is the "soul." The parent organization owns the corporation, ensuring profits can only fund the mission. You put it in Switzerland because they're good at keeping things neutral and also chocolate.

This structure lets you legally accept papers from everyone (foundations, political donors, and Wall Street) and aim them all at diseases instead of each other.

## Phase 4+: The Expansion Phases (Years 4-50)

The 1% treaty is just the beginning. Like all addictions, not-dying starts with a small dose and escalates. The real goal is eventually redirecting *most* military spending to health.

### Why Expansion Is Built Into The System

The treaty money splits [80/10/10](../appendix/incentive-alignment-bonds-paper.qmd): {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}} to clinical trials (the point), {{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}} to investors (the bribe), and {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}} to [political incentives](../appendix/incentive-alignment-bonds-paper.qmd) (the bribe for the other kind of human). That last slice is the interesting part, because it grows every time the treaty expands:

| Phase | Year | Treaty % | Political Incentive Pool | What Happens |
|:------|:-----|:---------|:------------------------|:-------------|
| 3 | 1-3 | 1% | {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_annual >}}/year | Treaty passes. Humans cautiously try not dying. |
| 4 | 4-7 | 2% | $5.44B/year | Politicians compete to expand (they've discovered voters like living) |
| 5 | 8-12 | 5% | $13.6B/year | Health lobby rivals defense lobby. Lobbyists switch suits. |
| 6 | 13-20 | 10% | $27.2B/year | "Funded pragmatic clinical trials" becomes the most rewarded phrase in politics |
| 7 | 21-35 | 25% | $68B/year | Superpowers compete on health outcomes (much less radioactive) |
| 8 | 36-50 | 50%+ | $136B+/year | Historians write confused books about why this took so long |

### Here's Why It Keeps Growing

**Bond investors** get {{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}} of all treaty funds. At 1%, that's {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns. At 2%, it doubles. At 10%, they're collecting ten times their original payout. So they will call their senator and say "please expand the treaty," not because they care about diseases but because they care about money. You don't have to ask them to do this. They will do it automatically, the way a plant grows toward sunlight except the sunlight is money and the plant is a billionaire. You've built a defense lobby in reverse.

**Politicians** see their [IAB-funded rewards](../appendix/incentive-alignment-bonds-paper.qmd) grow with each expansion. By Stage 4, the political incentive pool ($27.2B/year) exceeds all current global lobbying combined. At that point, "I support pragmatic clinical trial funding" becomes the most profitable sentence a politician can say, which means they will say it constantly, which means they will eventually believe it. This is how your species forms convictions.

### The Endgame

By 2075, the math becomes irresistible:

- $1.36+ trillion flows to health annually
- $136+ billion funds political incentives (more than all lobbying ever)
- $1.088+ trillion funds pragmatic clinical trials

The 1% treaty isn't the goal. It's the first 1%. Every investor and every politician makes more money if the number goes up, so they will push the number up. How far it goes depends on whether curing diseases turns out to be more popular than building bombs. Given that diseases kill approximately everyone and bombs kill approximately fewer people than diseases, the odds seem favorable. But you're humans, so nothing is certain.

![1.35 trillion moves from killing people to healing them. Some goes to bribing politicians, the rest to actual medicine. Priorities.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-the-endgame-bw-academic.jpg)
